news.headline: Tulane's coach says the mistakes can be fixed
news.summary: Will Hall took the blame for the offense after Saturday's 17-3 loss at Duke. Tulane was flagged for 15 penalties, and Hall changed quarterbacks at halftime.

news.headline: Duke beats Tulane 17-3 in the opener
news.summary: Tulane's offense never got going Saturday at Duke and the Green Wave managed only a field goal. Duke running back Nate Sheppard carried the ball 35 times for 227 yards and two touchdowns.

news.headline: Storms push back Tulane's opener at Duke
news.summary: Bad weather in Durham held up Saturday's game and the stadium was cleared for a while. Kickoff moved from 2:30 to 4:00 our time.

tv.name: SECN+
tv.note: On ESPN Unlimited (comes with YouTube TV)

news.headline: Florida receiver Eric Singleton may miss Saturday
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Singleton hurt his ankle in the win over Florida Atlantic and is highly questionable for the Campbell game. Sumrall said the team will not know for sure until later in the week.

news.headline: Two Florida players got hurt in the opener
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said receiver Eric Singleton Jr. hurt an ankle and running back Evan Pryor had a sore hip in Saturday's win. Sumrall did not know how bad either one is and will say more on Monday.

news.headline: Florida wins big in Jon Sumrall's first game
news.summary: The Gators beat Florida Atlantic 66-21 on Saturday night in a sold-out stadium. Jadan Baugh ran for 160 yards and three touchdowns, and Aaron Philo threw for 275 yards.

news.headline: Texas lineman Cole Hutson cannot play right now
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Hutson is not eligible because he went to two NFL tryout camps last spring. Texas is appealing to the NCAA, and Hutson has started 23 games for the Longhorns.

news.headline: Arch Manning throws four touchdown passes
news.summary: Texas opened the season Saturday with a 59-7 win over Texas State in Austin. Manning threw for 305 yards and four touchdowns before he came out of the game in the third quarter.

news.headline: Texas hosts top-ranked Ohio State on Saturday
news.summary: Arch Manning threw for 305 yards and four touchdowns in the opener, and now Texas gets a rematch with Ohio State in Austin. The Buckeyes beat Texas 14-7 in last year's opening game.

news.headline: Longtime Saints radio voice Mike Detillier dies
news.summary: Detillier talked about the Saints and LSU on WWL radio for more than 40 years. He died Sunday at age 65, and the Saints called him a true gentleman.

news.headline: Tyler Shough is the Saints starting quarterback
news.summary: The Saints put out their lineup chart Friday for the opener at Detroit. Tyler Shough is the starter, Spencer Rattler is behind him, and Travis Etienne Jr. and Alvin Kamara are both listed first at running back.

news.headline: Saints let go of two hurt players
news.summary: The Saints released running back Devin Neal and pass rusher Michael Heldman, who were both hurt in the preseason. The team paid them for their recovery time, and it can sign them again later.

news.headline: IUP sweeps Lake Erie for its fourth win in a row
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-23, 25-16 and 25-14 on Saturday at home. Charlotte Potvin had 11 kills, Delaney Concannon had 15 digs, and IUP is now 5-3.

news.headline: IUP beats Daemen to finish a perfect weekend
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks lost the first set Saturday at home and then won the next three, 25-20, 25-19 and 25-18. They went 4-0 in their own tournament, and Delaney Concannon had 19 kills and 20 digs.

news.headline: IUP beats Ashland in four sets at home
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks lost the first set 26-24 on Friday and then won the next three. Delaney Concannon had a season-best 20 kills, Jessica Neiman had 18, and IUP is now 4-3.

news.headline: Padres beat the Yankees 4-3 in San Diego
news.summary: San Diego hit three home runs in a row off Gerrit Cole to start the game Sunday. New York scored three runs in the eighth inning but could not catch up.

news.headline: Aaron Judge hits on the field again
news.summary: Judge took batting practice on the field in San Diego, his first since he went on the injured list in June with a hurt rib. Manager Aaron Boone said Judge could be back during the home stand that starts Tuesday.

news.headline: Yankees put Trent Grisham on the injured list
news.summary: The center fielder strained his right hamstring Friday night in San Diego and will miss at least 10 days. New York called up Jasson Dominguez from the minors to take his spot.
